caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical wrought iron fence or grille section, rendered in shades of black and gray on a plain, light beige background. The composition is centered on a vertical, cylindrical post with ornate decorative accents at the top and bottom, each resembling stylized acanthus leaves and a finial cap at the top. Extending horizontally from the central post are three evenly spaced iron rods on each side, forming the main bars of the structure. On either side of the central post, the two middle bars are adorned with intricate scrollwork, circular motifs, small rosettes, and leaf-like ornaments that mirror each other, creating a balanced design. The entire drawing is done in a monochromatic, grayscale palette and features detailed shading to indicate depth and texture of the metalwork.
title: Iron Fence
